name: NDR Auto Components Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, NDR Auto Components manufacturing seat frames and seat trims for passenger cars and utility vehicles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
NDRAC operates in the auto components industry, focusing on manufacturing of seat frames, trims, and related accessories for four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The company also manufactures, fabricates, and assembles automotive components, including seats and their spare parts, and is engaged in both manufacturing and trading of these components.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 51.8% CAGR over last 5 years
